text.zh: 相关管制：(1) 本条目不管制符合民用气象雷达国际标准的机载民用气象雷达，但其不得含有下列任一项：(a) 相控阵天线；(b) 频率捷变；(c) 扩频；或(d) 为跟踪运载工具而“专门设计”的信号处理。(2) 6A108.a中为“导弹”或《美国军品清单》物项“专门设计”或改装的物项“受ITAR管辖”（见22 CFR第120至130部分）。
text.en: Related Controls: (1) This entry does not control airborne civil weather radar conforming to international standards for civil weather radars provided that they do not incorporate any of the following: (a) Phased array antennas; (b) Frequency agility; (c) Spread spectrum; or (d) Signal processing “specially designed” for the tracking of vehicles. (2) Items in 6A108.a that are “specially designed” or modified for “missiles” or for items on the U.S. Munitions List are “subject to the ITAR” (see 22 CFR parts 120 through 130).

text.zh: 相关定义：激光雷达系统是采用专门的发射、扫描、接收和信号处理技术，利用激光进行回波测距、测向，以及根据位置、径向速度和目标体反射特征识别目标的系统。
text.en: Related Definitions: Laser radar systems are defined as those that embody specialized transmission, scanning, receiving and signal processing techniques for utilization of lasers for echo ranging, direction finding and discrimination of targets by location, radial speed and body reflection characteristics.

text.zh: 物项：a. 为用于“导弹”而设计或改装的雷达和激光雷达系统；
text.en: Items: a. Radar and laser radar systems designed or modified for use in “missiles”;

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 6A108.a包括下列物项：
text.en: 6A108.a includes the following:

text.zh: a. 地形轮廓测绘设备；
text.en: a. Terrain contour mapping equipment;

text.zh: b. 成像传感器设备；
text.en: b. Imaging sensor equipment;

text.zh: c. 景象测绘和相关设备（数字和模拟）；
text.en: c. Scene mapping and correlation (both digital and analog) equipment;

text.zh: d. 多普勒导航雷达设备。
text.en: d. Doppler navigation radar equipment.

text.zh: b. 可用于能够达到大于或等于300 km“航程”的火箭、导弹或无人航空器的下列精密跟踪系统：
text.en: b. Precision tracking systems, usable for rockets, missiles, or unmanned aerial vehicles capable of achieving a “range” equal to or greater than 300 km, as follows:

text.zh: b.1. 采用安装在火箭或无人航空器上的代码转换器，结合地面或机载基准或导航卫星系统，对飞行中的位置和速度提供实时测量的跟踪系统；
text.en: b.1. Tracking systems which use a code translator installed on the rocket or unmanned aerial vehicle in conjunction with either surface or airborne references or navigation satellite systems to provide real-time measurements of in-flight position and velocity;

text.zh: b.2. 同时具备以下全部能力的靶场测量雷达，包括相关光学/红外跟踪器：
text.en: b.2. Range instrumentation radars including associated optical/infrared trackers with all of the following capabilities:

text.zh: b.2.a. 角分辨率优于1.5毫弧度；
text.en: b.2.a. Angular resolution better than 1.5 milliradians;

text.zh: b.2.b. 作用距离为30 km或以上，且距离分辨率优于10 m rms；
text.en: b.2.b. Range of 30 km or greater with a range resolution better than 10 m rms;

text.zh: b.2.c. 速度分辨率优于3 m/s。
text.en: b.2.c. Velocity resolution better than 3 m/s.

text.zh: 相关管制：(1) 本条目管制物项的技术，见ECCN 6E001（“开发”）、6E002（“生产”）和6E201（“使用”）。(2) 另见ECCN 6A003.a.3和a.4。(3) 将抗辐射加固集成电路装入指定为EAR99的电视摄像机，这一行为本身并不使该电视摄像机达到ECCN 6A203.d款的参数。
text.en: Related Controls: (1) See ECCNs 6E001 (“development”), 6E002 (“production”), and 6E201 (“use”) for technology for items controlled under this entry. (2) Also see ECCN 6A003.a.3 and a.4. (3) The act of incorporating a radiation hardened integrated circuit into a TV camera designated as EAR99 does not, in and of itself, cause the TV camera to meet the parameters of ECCN paragraph 6A203.d.

text.zh: 相关定义：不适用
text.en: Related Definitions: N/A

text.zh: 物项：
text.en: Items:

text.zh: a. 下列条纹照相机及为其“专门设计”的部件：
text.en: a. Streak cameras and “specially designed” components therefor, as follows:

text.zh: a.1. 记录速度大于0.5 mm/µs的条纹照相机；
text.en: a.1. Streak cameras with writing speeds greater than 0.5 mm/µs;

text.zh: a.2. 时间分辨率可达50 ns或以下的电子条纹照相机；
text.en: a.2. Electronic streak cameras capable of 50 ns or less time resolution;

text.zh: a.3. 用于6A203.a.2所述照相机的条纹管；
text.en: a.3. Streak tubes for cameras described in 6A203.a.2;

text.zh: a.4. 为与模块化结构条纹照相机配合使用而“专门设计”，使其达到6A203.a.1或.a.2所述性能特性的插件；
text.en: a.4. Plug-ins, “specially designed” for use with streak cameras having modular structures, that enable the performance characteristics described in 6A203.a.1 or .a.2;

text.zh: a.5. 为6A203.a.1所述照相机“专门设计”的同步电子单元，以及由涡轮、反射镜和轴承组成的转子组件。
text.en: a.5. Synchronizing electronics units, and rotor assemblies consisting of turbines, mirrors and bearings, that are “specially designed” for cameras described in 6A203.a.1.

text.zh: b. 下列分幅照相机及为其“专门设计”的部件：
text.en: b. Framing cameras and “specially designed” components therefor, as follows:

text.zh: b.1. 记录速率大于每秒225,000帧的分幅照相机；
text.en: b.1. Framing cameras with recording rates greater than 225,000 frames per second;

text.zh: b.2. 每帧曝光时间可达50 ns或以下的分幅照相机；
text.en: b.2. Framing cameras capable of 50 ns or less frame exposure time;

text.zh: b.3. 快速图像选通（快门）时间为50 ns或以下，且为6A203.b.1或.b.2所述照相机“专门设计”的分幅管和固态成像器件；
text.en: b.3. Framing tubes, and solid-state imaging devices, that have a fast image gating (shutter) time of 50 ns or less and are “specially designed” for cameras described in 6A203.b.1 or .b.2;

text.zh: b.4. 为与模块化结构分幅照相机配合使用而“专门设计”，使其达到6A203.b.1或.b.2所述性能特性的插件；
text.en: b.4. Plug-ins, “specially designed” for use with framing cameras having modular structures, that enable the performance characteristics described in 6A203.b.1 or .b.2;

text.zh: b.5. 为6A203.b.1或.b.2所述照相机“专门设计”的同步电子单元，以及由涡轮、反射镜和轴承组成的转子组件。
text.en: b.5. Synchronizing electronic units, and rotor assemblies consisting of turbines, mirrors and bearings, that are “specially designed” for cameras described in 6A203.b.1 or .b.2.

text.zh: c. 下列固态或电子管照相机及为其“专门设计”的部件：
text.en: c. Solid-state or electron tube cameras and “specially designed” components therefor, as follows:

text.zh: c.1. 快速图像选通（快门）时间为50 ns或以下的固态照相机或电子管照相机；
text.en: c.1. Solid-state cameras, or electron tube cameras, with a fast image gating (shutter) time of 50 ns or less;

text.zh: c.2. 快速图像选通（快门）时间为50 ns或以下，且为6A203.c.1所述照相机“专门设计”的固态成像器件和像增强管；
text.en: c.2. Solid-state imaging devices, and image intensifiers tubes, that have a fast image gating (shutter) time of 50 ns or less and are “specially designed” for cameras described in 6A203.c.1;

text.zh: c.3. 快速图像选通（快门）时间为50 ns或以下的电光快门器件（克尔或普克尔盒）；
text.en: c.3. Electro-optical shuttering devices (Kerr or Pockels cells) with a fast image gating (shutter) time of 50 ns or less;

text.zh: c.4. 为与模块化结构照相机配合使用而“专门设计”，使其达到6A203.c.1所述性能特性的插件。
text.en: c.4. Plug-ins, “specially designed” for use with cameras having modular structures, that enable the performance characteristics described in 6A203.c.1.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 高速单帧照相机可单独使用，以生成动态事件的一幅图像；也可将多台此类照相机组合为顺序触发系统，以生成某一事件的多幅图像。
text.en: High speed single frame cameras can be used alone to produce a single image of a dynamic event, or several such cameras can be combined in a sequentially-triggered system to produce multiple images of an event.

text.zh: d. 为抗辐射加固而“专门设计”或额定，可承受大于5 × 10^{4} Gy（硅）的总辐射剂量且运行性能不降低的抗辐射加固电视摄像机或其镜头。
text.en: d. Radiation-hardened TV cameras, or lenses therefor, “specially designed” or rated as radiation hardened to withstand a total radiation dose greater than 5 × 10^{4} Gy (silicon) without operational degradation.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: Gy（硅）指未屏蔽硅样品受到电离辐射时，每千克吸收的能量（焦耳）。
text.en: The term Gy (silicon) refers to the energy in Joules per kilogram absorbed by an unshielded silicon sample when exposed to ionizing radiation.

text.zh: 物项：a. 同时具有以下两项特性的铜蒸气激光器：
text.en: Items: a. Copper vapor lasers having both of the following characteristics:

text.zh: a.1. 工作波长在500 nm与600 nm之间；以及
text.en: a.1. Operating at wavelengths between 500 nm and 600 nm; and

text.zh: a.2. 平均输出功率大于或等于30 W；
text.en: a.2. An average output power equal to or greater than 30 W;

text.zh: b. 同时具有以下两项特性的氩离子“激光器”：
text.en: b. Argon ion “lasers” having both of the following characteristics:

text.zh: b.1. 工作波长在400 nm与515 nm之间；以及
text.en: b.1. Operating at wavelengths between 400 nm and 515 nm; and

text.zh: b.2. 平均输出功率大于40 W；
text.en: b.2. An average output power greater than 40 W;

text.zh: c. 输出波长在1000 nm与1100 nm之间，且具有下列任一特性的掺钕（玻璃除外）激光器：
text.en: c. Neodymium-doped (other than glass) lasers with an output wavelength between 1000 nm and 1100 nm having either of the following:

text.zh: c.1. 脉冲激励且调Q，脉冲持续时间大于或等于1 ns，且具有下列任一特性：
text.en: c.1. Pulse-excited and Q-switched with a pulse duration equal to or greater than 1 ns, and having either of the following:

text.zh: c.1.a. 单横模输出且平均输出功率大于40 W；或
text.en: c.1.a. A single-transverse mode output with an average output power greater than 40 W; or

text.zh: c.1.b. 多横模输出且平均输出功率大于50 W；或
text.en: c.1.b. A multiple-transverse mode output with an average output power greater than 50 W; or

text.zh: c.2. 采用倍频使输出波长在500 nm与550 nm之间，且平均输出功率大于40 W。
text.en: c.2. Incorporating frequency doubling to give an output wavelength between 500 nm and 550 nm with an average output power of greater than 40 W.

text.zh: d. 同时具有以下全部特性的可调谐脉冲单模染料激光振荡器：
text.en: d. Tunable pulsed single-mode dye laser oscillators having all of the following characteristics:

text.zh: d.1. 工作波长在300 nm与800 nm之间；
text.en: d.1. Operating at wavelengths between 300 nm and 800 nm;

text.zh: d.2. 平均输出大于1 W；
text.en: d.2. An average output greater than 1 W;

text.zh: d.3. 重复频率大于1 kHz；以及
text.en: d.3. A repetition rate greater than 1 kHz; and

text.zh: d.4. 脉冲宽度小于100 ns；
text.en: d.4. Pulse width less than 100 ns;

text.zh: e. 同时具有以下全部特性的可调谐脉冲染料激光放大器和振荡器：
text.en: e. Tunable pulsed dye laser amplifiers and oscillators having all of the following characteristics:

text.zh: e.1. 工作波长在300 nm与800 nm之间；
text.en: e.1. Operating at wavelengths between 300 nm and 800 nm;

text.zh: e.2. 平均输出大于30 W；
text.en: e.2. An average output greater than 30 W;

text.zh: e.3. 重复频率大于1 kHz；以及
text.en: e.3. A repetition rate greater than 1 kHz; and

text.zh: e.4. 脉冲宽度小于100 ns；

text.zh: g.2. 重复频率大于250 Hz；

text.en: 6A205.g does not control the higher power (typically 1 kW to 5 kW) industrial CO_{2} lasers used in applications such as cutting and welding, as these latter lasers are either continuous wave or are pulsed with a pulse width greater than 200 ns.

text.zh: 物项：a. 光学滤光片：
text.en: Items: a. Optical filters:

text.zh: a.1. 用于大于250 nm的波长，由多层光学涂层组成，且具有下列任一特性：
text.en: a.1. For wavelengths longer than 250 nm, comprised of multi-layer optical coatings and having either of the following:

text.zh: a.1.a. 半强度全宽（FWHI）带宽小于或等于1 nm，且峰值透射率为90%或以上；或
text.en: a.1.a. Bandwidths equal to or less than 1 nm Full Width Half Intensity (FWHI) and peak transmission of 90% or more; or

text.zh: a.1.b. FWHI带宽小于或等于0.1 nm，且峰值透射率为50%或以上；
text.en: a.1.b. Bandwidths equal to or less than 0.1 nm FWHI and peak transmission of 50% or more;

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 6A994不管制具有固定空气隙的光学滤光片或Lyot型滤光片。
text.en: 6A994 does not control optical filters with fixed air gaps or Lyot-type filters.

text.zh: a.2. 用于大于250 nm的波长，且同时具有以下全部特性：
text.en: a.2. For wavelengths longer than 250 nm, and having all of the following:

text.zh: a.2.a. 可在500 nm或以上的光谱范围内调谐；
text.en: a.2.a. Tunable over a spectral range of 500 nm or more;

text.zh: a.2.b. 瞬时光学通带为1.25 nm或以下；
text.en: a.2.b. Instantaneous optical bandpass of 1.25 nm or less;

text.zh: a.2.c. 在可调谐光谱范围内，波长可在0.1 ms内重新设定，准确度为1 nm或更优；以及
text.en: a.2.c. Wavelength resettable within 0.1 ms to an accuracy of 1 nm or better within the tunable spectral range; and

text.zh: a.2.d. 单一峰值透射率为91%或以上；
text.en: a.2.d. A single peak transmission of 91% or more;

text.zh: a.3. 视场为30°或更宽、且响应时间小于或等于1 ns的光学不透明度开关（滤光片）；
text.en: a.3. Optical opacity switches (filters) with a field of view of 30° or wider and a response time equal to or less than 1 ns;

text.zh: b. 在大于1,000 nm但不超过3,000 nm的波长范围内，衰减小于4 dB/km的“氟化物光纤”光缆或其光纤。
text.en: b. “Fluoride fiber” cable, or optical fibers therefor, having an attenuation of less than 4 dB/km in the wavelength range exceeding 1,000 nm but not exceeding 3,000 nm.

text.zh: 物项：a. 具有下列任一特性的二氧化碳（CO_{2}）“激光器”：
text.en: Items: a. Carbon dioxide (CO_{2}) “lasers” having any of the following:

text.zh: a.1. 连续波输出功率超过10 kW；
text.en: a.1. A CW output power exceeding 10 kW;

text.zh: a.2. 脉冲输出的“脉冲持续时间”超过10微秒；以及
text.en: a.2. A pulsed output with a “pulse duration” exceeding 10 microseconds; and

text.zh: a.2.a. 平均输出功率超过10 kW；或
text.en: a.2.a. An average output power exceeding 10 kW; or

text.zh: a.2.b. 脉冲“峰值功率”超过100 kW；或
text.en: a.2.b. A pulsed “peak power” exceeding 100 kW; or

text.zh: a.3. 脉冲输出的“脉冲持续时间”小于或等于10微秒；以及
text.en: a.3. A pulsed output with a “pulse duration” equal to or less than 10 microseconds; and

text.zh: a.3.a. 每脉冲能量超过5 J且“峰值功率”超过2.5 kW；或
text.en: a.3.a. A pulse energy exceeding 5 J per pulse and “peak power” exceeding 2.5 kW; or

text.zh: a.3.b. 平均输出功率超过2.5 kW；
text.en: a.3.b. An average output power exceeding 2.5 kW;

text.zh: b. 下列半导体激光器：
text.en: b. Semiconductor lasers, as follows:

text.zh: b.1. 具有下列特性的单个单横模半导体“激光器”：
text.en: b.1. Individual, single-transverse mode semiconductor “lasers” having:

text.zh: b.1.a. 平均输出功率超过100 mW；或
text.en: b.1.a. An average output power exceeding 100 mW; or

text.zh: b.1.b. 波长超过1,050 nm；
text.en: b.1.b. A wavelength exceeding 1,050 nm;

text.zh: b.2. 波长超过1,050 nm的单个多横模半导体“激光器”，或单个半导体“激光器”组成的阵列；
text.en: b.2. Individual, multiple-transverse mode semiconductor “lasers”, or arrays of individual semiconductor “lasers”, having a wavelength exceeding 1,050 nm;

text.zh: c. 每脉冲输出能量超过20 J的红宝石“激光器”；
text.en: c. Ruby “lasers” having an output energy exceeding 20 J per pulse;

text.zh: d. 输出波长大于975 nm但不超过1,150 nm，且具有下列任一特性的非“可调谐”“脉冲激光器”：
text.en: d. Non-“tunable” “pulsed lasers” having an output wavelength exceeding 975 nm but not exceeding 1,150 nm and having any of the following:

text.zh: d.1. “脉冲持续时间”大于或等于1 ns但不超过1 µs，且具有下列任一特性：
text.en: d.1. A “pulse duration” equal to or exceeding 1 ns but not exceeding 1 µs, and having any of the following:

text.zh: d.1.a. 单横模输出且具有下列任一特性：
text.en: d.1.a. A single transverse mode output and having any of the following:

text.zh: d.1.a.1. “电光效率”超过12%、“平均输出功率”超过10 W，且能够以大于1 kHz的脉冲重复频率运行；或
text.en: d.1.a.1. A ‘wall-plug efficiency’ exceeding 12% and an “average output power” exceeding 10 W and capable of operating at a pulse repetition frequency greater than 1kHz; or

text.zh: d.1.a.2. “平均输出功率”超过20 W；或
text.en: d.1.a.2. An “average output power” exceeding 20 W; or

text.zh: d.1.b. 多横模输出且具有下列任一特性：
text.en: d.1.b. A multiple transverse mode output and having any of the following:

text.zh: d.1.b.1. “电光效率”超过18%且“平均输出功率”超过30 W；
text.en: d.1.b.1. A ‘wall-plug efficiency’ exceeding 18% and an “average output power” exceeding 30 W;

text.zh: d.1.b.2. “峰值功率”超过200 MW；或
text.en: d.1.b.2. A “peak power” exceeding 200 MW; or

text.zh: d.1.b.3. “平均输出功率”超过50 W；或
text.en: d.1.b.3. An “average output power” exceeding 50 W; or

text.zh: d.2. “脉冲持续时间”超过1 µs，且具有下列任一特性：
text.en: d.2. A “pulse duration” exceeding 1 µs and having any of the following:

text.zh: d.2.a. 单横模输出且具有下列任一特性：
text.en: d.2.a. A single transverse mode output and having any of the following:

text.zh: d.2.a.1. “电光效率”超过12%、“平均输出功率”超过10 W，且能够以大于1 kHz的脉冲重复频率运行；或
text.en: d.2.a.1. A ‘wall-plug efficiency’ exceeding 12% and an “average output power” exceeding 10 W and capable of operating at a pulse repetition frequency greater than 1 kHz; or

text.zh: d.2.a.2. “平均输出功率”超过20 W；或
text.en: d.2.a.2. An “average output power” exceeding 20 W; or

text.zh: d.2.b. 多横模输出且具有下列任一特性：
text.en: d.2.b. A multiple transverse mode output and having any of the following:

text.zh: d.2.b.1. “电光效率”超过18%且“平均输出功率”超过30 W；或
text.en: d.2.b.1. A ‘wall-plug efficiency’ exceeding 18% and an “average output power” exceeding 30 W; or

text.zh: d.2.b.2. “平均输出功率”超过500 W；
text.en: d.2.b.2. An “average output power” exceeding 500 W;

text.zh: e. 输出波长大于975 nm但不超过1,150 nm，且具有下列任一特性的非“可调谐”连续波“（CW）激光器”：
text.en: e. Non-“tunable” continuous wave “(CW) lasers”, having an output wavelength exceeding 975 nm but not exceeding 1,150 nm and having any of the following:

text.zh: e.1. 单横模输出且具有下列任一特性：
text.en: e.1. A single transverse mode output and having any of the following:

text.zh: e.1.a. “电光效率”超过12%、“平均输出功率”超过10 W，且能够以大于1 kHz的脉冲重复频率运行；或
text.en: e.1.a. A ‘wall-plug efficiency’ exceeding 12% and an “average output power” exceeding 10 W and capable of operating at a pulse repetition frequency greater than 1 kHz; or

text.zh: e.1.b. “平均输出功率”超过50 W；或
text.en: e.1.b. An “average output power” exceeding 50 W; or

text.zh: e.2. 多横模输出且具有下列任一特性：
text.en: e.2. A multiple transverse mode output and having any of the following:

text.zh: e.2.a. “电光效率”超过18%且“平均输出功率”超过30 W；或
text.en: e.2.a. A ‘wall-plug efficiency’ exceeding 18% and an “average output power” exceeding 30 W; or

text.zh: e.2.b. “平均输出功率”超过500 W；
text.en: e.2.b. An “average output power” exceeding 500 W;

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 6A995.e.2.b不管制输出功率小于或等于2 kW且总质量大于1,200 kg的多横模工业“激光器”。就本注而言，总质量包括运行“激光器”所需的所有“部件”，例如“激光器”、电源和热交换器，但不包括用于光束调节和/或传输的外部光学器件。
text.en: 6A995.e.2.b does not control multiple transverse mode, industrial “lasers” with output power less than or equal to 2kW with a total mass greater than 1,200kg. For the purpose of this note, total mass includes all “components” required to operate the “laser,” e.g., “laser,” power supply, heat exchanger, but excludes external optics for beam conditioning and/or delivery.

text.zh: f. 波长大于1,400 nm但不超过1555 nm，且具有下列任一特性的非“可调谐”“激光器”：
text.en: f. Non-“tunable” “lasers”, having a wavelength exceeding 1,400 nm, but not exceeding 1555 nm and having any of the following:

text.zh: f.1. 每脉冲输出能量超过100 mJ且脉冲“峰值功率”超过1 W；或
text.en: f.1. An output energy exceeding 100 mJ per pulse and a pulsed “peak power” exceeding 1 W; or

text.zh: f.2. 平均或连续波输出功率超过1 W。
text.en: f.2. An average or CW output power exceeding 1 W.

text.zh: g. 自由电子“激光器”。
text.en: g. Free electron “lasers”.

text.zh: a. 其他未列明、“灵敏度”低于（优于）1.0 nT（rms）/√Hz的“磁力计”。
text.en: a. “Magnetometers”, n.e.s., having a 'sensitivity' lower (better) than 1.0 nT (rms) per square root Hz.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就6A996而言，“灵敏度”（噪声水平）是设备自身限制的噪声本底的均方根值，该噪声本底即能够测量的最低信号。
text.en: For the purposes of 6A996, 'sensitivity' (noise level) is the root mean square of the device-limited noise floor which is the lowest signal that can be measured.

text.zh: b. “超导”电磁传感器、由“超导”材料制造且同时具有以下全部特性的“部件”：
text.en: b. “Superconductive” electromagnetic sensors, “components” manufactured from “superconductive” materials and having all the following:

text.zh: b.1. 设计为在低于其至少一种“超导”组成材料的“临界温度”下运行（包括约瑟夫森效应器件或“超导”量子干涉器件〔SQUIDS〕）；
text.en: b.1. Designed for operation at temperatures below the “critical temperature” of at least one of their “superconductive” constituents (including Josephson effect devices or “superconductive” quantum interference devices (SQUIDS));

text.zh: b.2. 设计为感测1 KHz或以下频率的电磁场变化；以及
text.en: b.2. Designed for sensing electromagnetic field variations at frequencies of 1 KHz or less; and

text.zh: b.3. 具有下列任一特性：
text.en: b.3. Having any of the following characteristics:

text.zh: b.3.a. 采用最小特征尺寸小于2 µm的薄膜SQUIDS，并具有相关输入和输出耦合电路；
text.en: b.3.a. Incorporating thin-film SQUIDS with a minimum feature size of less than 2 µm and with associated input and output coupling circuits;

text.zh: b.3.b. 设计为在磁场变化率超过每秒1 × 10^{6}个磁通量子时运行；

text.en: For the purposes of 6C002.b.1, 'mole fraction' is defined as the ratio of moles of ZnTe to the sum of the moles of CdTe and ZnTe present in the crystal.

text.zh: 物项：a. 采用化学气相沉积工艺生产，且具有下列任一特性的硒化锌（ZnSe）和硫化锌（ZnS）“衬底坯料”：
text.en: Items: a. Zinc selenide (ZnSe) and zinc sulfide (ZnS) “substrate blanks”, produced by the chemical vapor deposition process and having any of the following:

text.zh: a.1. 体积大于100 cm^{3}；或
text.en: a.1. A volume greater than 100 cm^{3}; or

text.zh: a.2. 直径大于80 mm，且厚度为20 mm或以上；
text.en: a.2. A diameter greater than 80 mm and a thickness of 20 mm or more;

text.zh: b. 下列电光材料和非线性材料：
text.en: b. Electro-optic materials and non-linear materials, as follows:

text.zh: b.1. 砷酸钛氧钾（KTA）（CAS 59400-80-5）；
text.en: b.1. Potassium titanyl arsenate (KTA) (CAS 59400-80-5);

text.zh: b.2. 硒镓银（AgGaSe_{2}，也称AGSE）（CAS 12002-67-4）；
text.en: b.2. Silver gallium selenide (AgGaSe_{2}, also known as AGSE) (CAS 12002-67-4);

text.zh: b.3. 硒砷铊（Tl_{3}AsSe_{3}，也称TAS）（CAS 16142-89-5）；
text.en: b.3. Thallium arsenic selenide (Tl_{3}AsSe_{3}, also known as TAS) (CAS 16142-89-5);

text.zh: b.4. 磷锗锌（ZnGeP_{2}，也称ZGP、二磷化锌锗〔zinc germanium biphosphide或zinc germanium diphosphide〕）；或
text.en: b.4. Zinc germanium phosphide (ZnGeP_{2}, also known as ZGP, zinc germanium biphosphide or zinc germanium diphosphide); or
b.5. Gallium selenide (GaSe) (CAS 12024-11-2);

text.zh: c. 6C004.b所列以外、具有下列任一特性的非线性光学材料：
text.en: c. Non-linear optical materials, other than those specified by 6C004.b, having any of the following:

text.zh: c.1. 具有以下全部特性：
text.en: c.1. Having all of the following:

text.zh: c.1.a. 动态（也称非稳态）三阶非线性极化率（χ^{(3)}，chi 3）为10^{−6} m^{2}/V^{2}或以上；以及
text.en: c.1.a. Dynamic (also known as nonstationary) third order nonlinear susceptibility (χ^{(3)}, chi 3) of 10^{−6} m^{2}/V^{2} or more; and

text.zh: c.1.b. 响应时间小于1 ms；或
text.en: c.1.b. Response time of less than 1 ms; or

text.zh: c.2. 二阶非线性极化率（χ^{(2)}，chi 2）为3.3 × 10^{−11} m/V或以上；
text.en: c.2. Second order nonlinear susceptibility (χ^{(2)}, chi 2) of 3.3 × 10^{−11} m/V or more;

text.zh: d. 直径或长轴长度超过300 mm的碳化硅或铍—铍（Be/Be）沉积材料“衬底坯料”；
text.en: d. “Substrate blanks” of silicon carbide or beryllium beryllium (Be/Be) deposited materials, exceeding 300 mm in diameter or major axis length;

text.zh: e. 玻璃，包括熔融石英、磷酸盐玻璃、氟磷酸盐玻璃、氟化锆（ZrF_{4}）（CAS 7783-64-4）和氟化铪（HfF_{4}）（CAS 13709-52-9），且同时具有以下全部特性：
text.en: e. Glass, including fused silica, phosphate glass, fluorophosphate glass, zirconium fluoride (ZrF_{4}) (CAS 7783-64-4) and hafnium fluoride (HfF_{4}) (CAS 13709-52-9) and having all of the following:

text.zh: e.1. 氢氧根离子（OH-）浓度低于5 ppm；
text.en: e.1. A hydroxyl ion (OH-) concentration of less than 5 ppm;

text.zh: e.2. 综合金属纯度水平低于1 ppm；以及
text.en: e.2. Integrated metallic purity levels of less than 1 ppm; and

text.zh: e.3. 高均匀性（折射率变化）小于5 × 10^{−6}；
text.en: e.3. High homogeneity (index of refraction variance) less than 5 × 10^{−6};

text.zh: f. 在大于200 nm但不超过14,000 nm的波长范围内，吸收系数小于10^{−5} cm^{−1}的合成金刚石材料。
text.en: f. Synthetically produced diamond material with an absorption of less than 10^{−5} cm^{−1} for wavelengths exceeding 200 nm but not exceeding 14,000 nm.

text.zh: b. 具有下列任一特性的稀土金属掺杂双包层光纤：
text.en: b. Rare-earth-metal doped double-clad fibers having any of the following:

text.zh: b.1. 标称“激光”波长为975 nm至1,150 nm，且同时具有以下全部特性：
text.en: b.1. Nominal “laser” wavelength of 975 nm to 1,150 nm and having all of the following:

text.zh: b.1.a. 平均纤芯直径大于或等于25 µm；以及
text.en: b.1.a. Average core diameter equal to or greater than 25 µm; and

text.zh: b.1.b. 纤芯“数值孔径”（“NA”）小于0.065；或
text.en: b.1.b. Core 'Numerical Aperture' ('NA') less than 0.065; or
Note to 6C005.b.1:

text.zh: 6C005.b.1不适用于内玻璃包层直径超过150 µm但不超过300 µm的双包层光纤。
text.en: 6C005.b.1 does not apply to double-clad fibers having an inner glass cladding diameter exceeding 150 µm and not exceeding 300 µm.

text.zh: b.2. 标称“激光”波长超过1,530 nm，且同时具有以下全部特性：
text.en: b.2. Nominal “laser” wavelength exceeding 1,530 nm and having all of the following:

text.zh: b.2.a. 平均纤芯直径大于或等于20 µm；以及
text.en: b.2.a. Average core diameter equal to or greater than 20 µm; and

text.zh: b.2.b. 纤芯“NA”小于0.1。
text.en: b.2.b. Core 'NA' less than 0.1.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Notes:

text.zh: 1. 就6C005.b.1.b而言，纤芯“数值孔径”（“NA”）在光纤发射波长处测量。
text.en: 1. For the purposes of 6C005.b.1.b, the core 'Numerical Aperture' ('NA') is measured at the emission wavelengths of the fiber.

text.zh: 2. 6C005.b包括装有端帽的光纤。
text.en: 2. 6C005.b includes fibers assembled with end caps.

text.zh: 物项：
text.en: Items:

text.zh: 声学
text.en: Acoustics

text.zh: a. 下列“软件”：
text.en: a. “Software” as follows:

text.zh: a.1. 为采用拖曳水听器阵列进行被动接收时，对声学数据进行“实时处理”的声波束形成而“专门设计”的“软件”；
text.en: a.1. “Software” “specially designed” for acoustic beam forming for the “real-time processing” of acoustic data for passive reception using towed hydrophone arrays;

text.zh: a.2. 用于采用拖曳水听器阵列进行被动接收时，对声学数据进行“实时处理”的“源代码”；
text.en: a.2. “Source code” for the “real-time processing” of acoustic data for passive reception using towed hydrophone arrays;

text.zh: a.3. 为采用海底或海湾电缆系统进行被动接收时，对声学数据进行“实时处理”的声波束形成而“专门设计”的“软件”；
text.en: a.3. “Software” “specially designed” for acoustic beam forming for the “real-time processing” of acoustic data for passive reception using bottom or bay cable systems;

text.zh: a.4. 用于采用海底或海湾电缆系统进行被动接收时，对声学数据进行“实时处理”的“源代码”；
text.en: a.4. “Source code” for the “real-time processing” of acoustic data for passive reception using bottom or bay cable systems;

text.zh: a.5. 为以下全部用途而“专门设计”的“软件”或“源代码”：
text.en: a.5. “Software” or “source code”, “specially designed” for all of the following:

text.zh: a.5.a. 对6A001.a.1.e管制声纳系统的声学数据进行“实时处理”；以及
text.en: a.5.a. “Real-time processing” of acoustic data from sonar systems controlled by 6A001.a.1.e; and

text.zh: a.5.b. 自动探测、分类并确定潜水员或游泳者的位置；
text.en: a.5.b. Automatically detecting, classifying and determining the location of divers or swimmers;

text.zh: 注意：
text.en: N.B.:

text.zh: 为军用而“专门设计”或改装的潜水员探测“软件”或“源代码”，见《国际武器贸易条例》（ITAR）（22 CFR第121部分）中的《美国军品清单》。
text.en: For diver detection “software” or “source code”, “specially designed” or modified for military use, see the U.S. Munitions List of the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) (22 CFR part 121).

text.zh: b. 光学传感器。无。
text.en: b. Optical sensors. None.

text.zh: 照相机
text.en: Cameras

text.zh: c. 为采用6A002.a.3.f所列“焦平面阵列”的照相机设计或改装，且为移除帧率限制、使照相机超过6A003.b.4注3.a所列帧率而设计或改装的“软件”；
text.en: c. “Software” designed or modified for cameras incorporating “focal plane arrays” specified by 6A002.a.3.f and designed or modified to remove a frame rate restriction and allow the camera to exceed the frame rate specified in 6A003.b.4 Note 3.a;

text.zh: 光学
text.en: Optics

text.zh: d. 为保持分段反射镜系统的对准和相位关系而“专门设计”的“软件”，该系统由直径或长轴长度大于或等于1 m的反射镜分段组成；
text.en: d. “Software” “specially designed” to maintain the alignment and phasing of segmented mirror systems consisting of mirror segments having a diameter or major axis length equal to or larger than 1 m;

text.zh: e. 激光器。无。
text.en: e. Lasers. None.

text.zh: 磁场和电场传感器
text.en: Magnetic and Electric Field Sensors

text.zh: f. 下列“软件”：
text.en: f. “Software” as follows:

text.zh: f.1. 为设计在移动平台上运行的磁传感器的磁场和电场“补偿系统”而“专门设计”的“软件”；
text.en: f.1. “Software” “specially designed” for magnetic and electric field “compensation systems” for magnetic sensors designed to operate on mobile platforms;

text.zh: f.2. 为移动平台上的磁场和电场异常探测而“专门设计”的“软件”；
text.en: f.2. “Software” “specially designed” for magnetic and electric field anomaly detection on mobile platforms;

text.zh: f.3. 为使用6A006.e所列水下电磁接收机对电磁数据进行“实时处理”而“专门设计”的“软件”；
text.en: f.3. “Software” “specially designed” for “real-time processing” of electromagnetic data using underwater electromagnetic receivers specified by 6A006.e;

text.zh: f.4. 用于使用6A006.e所列水下电磁接收机对电磁数据进行“实时处理”的“源代码”；
text.en: f.4. “Source code” for “real-time processing” of electromagnetic data using underwater electromagnetic receivers specified by 6A006.e;

text.zh: 重力仪
text.en: Gravimeters

text.zh: g. 为校正重力仪或重力梯度仪的运动影响而“专门设计”的“软件”；
text.en: g. “Software” “specially designed” to correct motional influences of gravity meters or gravity gradiometers;

text.zh: 雷达
text.en: Radar

text.zh: h. 下列“软件”：
text.en: h. “Software” as follows:

text.zh: h.1. 设计为运行在空中交通管制中心的通用计算机上，且能够接收四部以上一次雷达的雷达目标数据的空中交通管制（ATC）“软件”；
text.en: h.1. Air Traffic Control (ATC) “software” designed to be hosted on general purpose computers located at Air Traffic Control centers and capable of accepting radar target data from more than four primary radars;

text.zh: h.2. 用于设计或“生产”同时具有以下全部特性的雷达天线罩的“软件”：
text.en: h.2. “Software” for the design or “production” of radomes having all of the following:

text.zh: h.2.a. 为保护6A008.e所列“电子扫描阵列天线”而“专门设计”；以及
text.en: h.2.a. “Specially designed” to protect the “electronically scanned array antennae” specified by 6A008.e; and

text.zh: h.2.b. 使天线方向图的“平均旁瓣电平”低于主波束峰值电平超过40 dB。
text.en: h.2.b. Resulting in an antenna pattern having an 'average side lobe level' more than 40 dB below the peak of the main beam level.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就6D003.h.2.b而言，“平均旁瓣电平”在整个阵列范围测量，但不包括主波束及主波束两侧前两个旁瓣的角度范围。
text.en: For the purposes of 6D003.h.2.b 'average side lobe level' is measured over the entire array excluding the angular extent of the main beam and the first two side lobes on either side of the main beam.

text.en: d.1. “Technology” “required” for the coating and treatment of optical surfaces to achieve an 'optical thickness' uniformity of 99.5% or better for optical coatings 500 mm or more in diameter or major axis length and with a total loss (absorption and scatter) of less than 5 × 10^{−3};

(2) This entry only controls “technology” for items in 6A002.a.1 and a.3 that are “specially designed” or modified to protect “missiles” against nuclear effects (e.g., Electromagnetic Pulse (EMP), X-rays, combined blast and thermal effects), and usable for “missiles.” (3) This entry only controls “technology” for items in 6A007.b and .c when the accuracies in 6A007.b.1 and b.2 are met or exceeded.

text.zh: 物项：a. 在任一单轴上以每年超过10 m^{2}表面积的速率批量生产光学“零件”和“部件”的光学制造技术，且同时具有以下全部特性：
text.en: Items: a. Optical fabrication technologies for serially producing optical “parts” and “components” at a rate exceeding 10 m^{2} of surface area per year on any single spindle and having all of the following:

text.zh: a.1. 面积超过1 m^{2}；以及
text.en: a.1. Area exceeding 1 m^{2}; and

text.zh: a.2. 在设计波长下面形超过λ/10（rms）；
text.en: a.2. Surface figure exceeding λ/10 (rms) at the designed wavelength;

text.zh: b. 带宽小于或等于10 nm、视场（FOV）超过40°且分辨率超过每毫弧度0.75线对的光学滤光片的“技术”；
text.en: b. “Technology” for optical filters with a bandwidth equal to or less than 10 nm, a field of view (FOV) exceeding 40° and a resolution exceeding 0.75 line pairs per milliradian;

text.zh: c. 用于“开发”或“生产”6A993管制照相机的“技术”；
text.en: c. “Technology” for the “development” or “production” of cameras controlled by 6A993;

text.zh: d. “开发”或“生产”具有下列任一特性的非三轴磁通门“磁力计”或非三轴磁通门“磁力计”系统所“必需”的“技术”：
text.en: d. “Technology” “required” for the “development” or “production” of non-triaxial fluxgate “magnetometers” or non-triaxial fluxgate “magnetometer” systems, having any of the following:

text.zh: d.1. 在小于1 Hz的频率下，“灵敏度”低于（优于）0.05 nT（rms）/√Hz；或
text.en: d.1. ‘Sensitivity’ lower (better) than 0.05 nT (rms) per square root Hz at frequencies of less than 1 Hz; or

text.zh: d.2. 在1 Hz或以上的频率下，“灵敏度”低于（优于）1 × 10^{−3} nT（rms）/√Hz。
text.en: d.2. ‘Sensitivity’ lower (better) than 1 × 10^{−3} nT (rms) per square root Hz at frequencies of 1 Hz or more.

text.zh: e. “开发”或“生产”同时具有以下全部特性的红外上转换器件所“必需”的“技术”：
text.en: e. “Technology” “required” for the “development” or “production” of infrared up-conversion devices having all of the following:

text.zh: e.1. 在大于700 nm但不超过1500 nm的波长范围具有响应；以及
text.en: e.1. A response in the wavelength range exceeding 700 nm but not exceeding 1500 nm; and

text.zh: e.2. 由红外光电探测器、发光二极管（OLED）和纳米晶体组合，将红外光转换为可见光。
text.en: e.2. A combination of an infrared photodetector, light emitting diode (OLED), and nanocrystal to convert infrared light into visible light.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就6E993而言，“灵敏度”（或噪声水平）是设备自身限制的噪声本底的均方根值，该噪声本底即能够测量的最低信号。
text.en: For the purposes of 6E993, ‘sensitivity’ (or noise level) is the root mean square of the device-limited noise floor which is the lowest signal that can be measured.

text.zh: a.1. 规定可在线加速度小于或等于15 g时工作，且具有下列任一特性：
text.en: a.1. Specified to function at linear acceleration levels less than or equal to 15 g and having any of the following:

text.zh: 7A003不适用于已由一个或多个《瓦森纳安排》参与国民航主管机关认证用于“民用航空器”的“惯性测量设备或系统”，见EAR第743部分附件1。
text.en: 7A003 does not apply to 'inertial measurement equipment or systems' which are certified for use on “civil aircraft” by civil aviation authorities of one or more Wassenaar Arrangement Participating States, see Supplement No. 1 to part 743 of the EAR.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Notes:

text.zh: 1. 就7A003而言，“惯性测量设备或系统”采用加速度计或陀螺仪测量速度和方向变化，以在对准后无需外部基准即可确定或保持航向或位置。“惯性测量设备或系统”包括：
text.en: 1. For the purposes of 7A003, 'inertial measurement equipment or systems' incorporate accelerometers or gyroscopes to measure changes in velocity and orientation in order to determine or maintain heading or position without requiring an external reference once aligned. 'Inertial measurement equipment or systems' include:

text.zh: 姿态航向参考系统（AHRS）；
text.en: Attitude and Heading Reference Systems (AHRSs);

text.zh: 陀螺罗经；
text.en: Gyrocompasses;

text.zh: 惯性测量单元（IMU）；
text.en: Inertial Measurement Units (IMUs);

text.zh: 惯性导航系统（INS）；
text.en: Inertial Navigation Systems (INSs);

text.zh: 惯性参考系统（IRS）；
text.en: Inertial Reference Systems (IRSs);

text.zh: 惯性参考单元（IRU）。
text.en: Inertial Reference Units (IRUs).

text.zh: 2. 就7A003而言，“位置辅助基准”独立提供位置，包括：
text.en: 2. For the purposes of 7A003, 'positional aiding references' independently provide position, and include:

text.zh: a. “卫星导航系统”；
text.en: a. “Satellite navigation system”;

text.zh: b. “基于数据库的参考导航”（“DBRN”）。
text.en: b.”Data-Based Referenced Navigation” (“DBRN”).

text.zh: a. 为“航空器”、陆地车辆或船舶设计，不使用“位置辅助基准”即可提供位置，且在正常对准后具有下列任一“准确度”：
text.en: a. Designed for “aircraft”, land vehicles or vessels, providing position without the use of 'positional aiding references', and having any of the following “accuracies” subsequent to normal alignment:

text.zh: a.1. “圆概率误差”（“CEP”）速率为每小时0.8海里（nm/hr）或以下（更优）；
text.en: a.1. 0.8 nautical miles per hour (nm/hr) “Circular Error Probable” (“CEP”) rate or less (better);

text.zh: a.2. “CEP”为行进距离的0.5%或以下（更优）；或
text.en: a.2. 0.5% distanced travelled “CEP” or less (better); or

text.zh: a.3. 24小时内总漂移“CEP”为1海里或以下（更优）；
text.en: a.3. Total drift of 1 nautical mile “CEP” or less (better) in a 24 hr period;

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就7A003.a.1、7A003.a.2和7A003.a.3而言，这些性能参数通常分别适用于为“航空器”、车辆及船舶设计的“惯性测量设备或系统”。这些参数来自采用专用的非“位置辅助基准”（例如高度计、里程计、速度计程仪）。因此，规定的性能值不能在这些参数之间直接换算。为多种平台设计的设备，须按照每个适用条目7A003.a.1、7A003.a.2或7A003.a.3进行评估。
text.en: For the purposes of 7A003.a.1, 7A003.a.2 and 7A003.a.3, the performance parameters typically apply to 'inertia measurement equipment or systems' designed for “aircraft”, vehicles and vessels, respectively. These parameters result from the utilization of specialized non-'positional aiding references' (e.g., altimeter, odometer, velocity log). As a consequence, the specified performance values cannot be readily converted between these parameters. Equipment designed for multiple platforms are evaluated against each applicable entry 7A003.a.1, 7A003.a.2, or 7A003.a.3.

text.zh: b. 为“航空器”、陆地车辆或船舶设计，内置“位置辅助基准”，且在全部“位置辅助基准”丢失后长达4分钟期间提供位置，“准确度”小于（优于）10米“CEP”；
text.en: b. Designed for “aircraft”, land vehicles or vessels, with an embedded 'positional aiding reference' and providing position after loss of all 'positional aiding references' for a period of up to 4 minutes, having an “accuracy” of less (better) than 10 meters “CEP”;

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就7A003.b而言，本条目指为提升性能，将“惯性测量设备或系统”与其他独立“位置辅助基准”内置于单一单元（即嵌入式）的系统。
text.en: For the purposes of 7A003.b, this entry refers to systems in which 'inertial measurement equipment or systems' and other independent 'positional aiding references' are built into a single unit (i.e., embedded) in order to achieve improved performance.

text.zh: c. 为“航空器”、陆地车辆或船舶设计，提供航向或真北确定，且具有下列任一特性：
text.en: c. Designed for “aircraft”, land vehicles or vessels, providing heading or True North determination and having any of the following:

text.zh: c.1. 最大工作角速率小于500 deg/s，且在不使用“位置辅助基准”时航向“准确度”小于或等于（优于）0.07 deg sec (Lat)（相当于纬度45度时6角分rms）；或
text.en: c.1. A maximum operating angular rate less (lower) than 500 deg/s and a heading “accuracy” without the use of 'positional aiding references' equal to or less (better) than 0.07 deg sec (Lat) (equivalent to 6 arc minutes rms at 45 degrees latitude); or

text.zh: c.2. 最大工作角速率大于或等于500 deg/s，且在不使用“位置辅助基准”时航向“准确度”小于或等于（优于）0.2 deg sec (Lat)（相当于纬度45度时17角分rms）；
text.en: c.2. A maximum operating angular rate equal to or greater (higher) than 500 deg/s and a heading “accuracy” without the use of 'positional aiding references' equal to or less (better) than 0.2 deg sec (Lat) (equivalent to 17 arc minutes rms at 45 degrees latitude);

text.zh: d. 提供一个以上维度的加速度测量或角速率测量，且具有下列任一特性：
text.en: d. Providing acceleration measurements or angular rate measurements, in more than one dimension, and having any of the following:

text.zh: d.1. 不使用任何辅助基准时，任一轴上具有7A001或7A002所列性能；或
text.en: d.1. Performance specified by 7A001 or 7A002 along any axis, without the use of any aiding references; or

text.zh: d.2. 属于“航天级”，且提供的角速率测量在任一轴上的“角随机游走”小于或等于（优于）0.1度/√小时。
text.en: d.2. Being “space-qualified” and providing angular rate measurements having an “angle random walk” along any axis of less (better) than or equal to 0.1 degree per square root hour.

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 7A003.d.2不适用于所含陀螺仪仅为“旋转质量陀螺仪”的“惯性测量设备或系统”。
text.en: 7A003.d.2 does not apply to 'inertial measurement equipment or systems' that contain “spinning mass gyros” as the only type of gyro.

text.en: Related Controls: (1) See USML Category XII(e) for gyros or angular rate sensors subject to the ITAR. (2) See also ECCNs 7A002, 7A611, and 7A994.

text.zh: 相关定义：(1) 漂移率定义为输出偏离期望输出的时间变化率，包含随机分量和系统分量，以相对于惯性空间单位时间的等效角位移表示。(2) 稳定性定义为在稳定温度条件下测得的某一参数相对于其校准值变化的标准差（1个西格玛），可表示为时间的函数。
text.en: Related Definitions: (1) Drift rate is defined as the time rate of output deviation from the desired output. It consists of random and systematic components and is expressed as an equivalent angular displacement per unit time with respect to inertial space. (2) Stability is defined as standard deviation (1 sigma) of the variation of a particular parameter from its calibrated value measured under stable temperature conditions. This can be expressed as a function of time.

text.zh: 物项：a. 可用于“射程/航程”等于或大于300 km的火箭、导弹或无人驾驶航空器，且在1 g环境下额定“漂移率”的‘稳定性’小于每小时0.5度（1个西格玛或均方根）的所有类型陀螺仪。
text.en: Items: a. All types of gyros, usable in rockets, missiles, or unmanned aerial vehicles capable of achieving a “range” equal to or greater than 300 km, with a rated “drift rate” ‘stability’ of less than 0.5 degrees (1 sigma or rms) per hour in a 1 g environment.

text.zh: b. 设计用于惯性导航系统或各类制导系统，并规定可在大于100 g的加速度水平下工作的任何类型陀螺仪。
text.en: b. Gyros of any type, designed for use in inertial navigation systems or in guidance systems of all types, specified to function at acceleration levels greater than 100 g.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 本条中，‘稳定性’定义为衡量特定机构或性能系数在持续处于固定工作条件时保持不变的能力。（此定义不涉及动态稳定性或伺服稳定性。）（IEEE STD 528-2001第2.247款）。
text.en: In this entry, the term ‘stability’ is defined as a measure of the ability of a specific mechanism or performance coefficient to remain invariant when continuously exposed to a fixed operating condition. (This definition does not refer to dynamic or servo stability.) (IEEE STD 528-2001 paragraph 2.247).

text.en: Related Controls: (1) See ECCN 7A003 and 7A994. (2) Inertial navigation systems and inertial equipment, and “specially designed” “parts” and “components” therefor specifically designed, modified or configured for military use are “subject to the ITAR” (see 22 CFR parts 120 through 130).

text.zh: 相关定义：7A103.a所述‘惯性测量设备或系统’采用加速度计或陀螺仪测量速度及方向变化，以便在完成对准后无需外部参考即可确定或保持航向或位置。
text.en: Related Definitions: 'Inertial measurement equipment or systems' specified in 7A103.a. incorporate accelerometers or gyros to measure changes in velocity and orientation in order to determine or maintain heading or position without requiring an external reference once aligned.

text.zh: 物项：a. 使用7A001、7A002、7A101或7A102所管制加速度计或陀螺仪的‘惯性测量设备或系统’，以及为其“专门设计”的“零件”和“组件”；
text.en: Items: a. 'Inertial measurement equipment or systems' using accelerometers or gyros controlled by 7A001, 7A002, 7A101 or 7A102, and “specially designed” “parts” and “components” therefor;
Note 1:

text.zh: 7A103.a不管制包含为井下作业“专门设计”并开发为随钻测量（MWD）传感器的加速度计的设备。
text.en: 7A103.a does not control equipment containing accelerometers “specially designed” and developed as MWD (Measurement While Drilling) sensors for use in down-hole well services operations.
Note 2:

text.zh: 7A103.a不管制使用7A001或7A002所管制且仅因NS理由受控的加速度计或陀螺仪的惯性设备或其他设备。
text.en: 7A103.a does not control inertial or other equipment using accelerometers or gyros controlled by 7A001 or 7A002 that are only NS controlled.
Note 3:

text.zh: 7A103.a包括姿态航向参考系统（AHRS）、陀螺罗盘、惯性测量单元（IMU）、惯性导航系统（INS）、惯性参考系统（IRS）和惯性参考单元（IRU）。
text.en: 7A103.a. includes Attitude and Heading Reference Systems (AHRSs), gyrocompasses, Inertial Measurement Units (IMUs), Inertial Navigations Systems (INSs), Inertial Reference Systems (IRSs), and Inertial Reference Units (IRUs).

text.zh: b. 设计或改装用于“射程/航程”等于或大于300 km的火箭、导弹或无人驾驶航空器，包含陀螺稳定器或自动驾驶仪的综合飞行仪表系统，以及为其“专门设计”的“零件”和“组件”。
text.en: b. Integrated flight instrument systems, which include gyrostabilizers or automatic pilots, designed or modified for use in rockets, missiles, or unmanned aerial vehicles capable of achieving a “range” equal to or greater than 300 km, and “specially designed” “parts” and “components” therefor.

text.zh: c. 设计或改装用于“射程/航程”等于或大于300 km的火箭、导弹或无人驾驶航空器，并能够提供圆概率误差（CEP）为200m或更小的导航精度的综合导航系统。
text.en: c. Integrated Navigation Systems, designed or modified for use in rockets, missiles, or unmanned aerial vehicles capable of achieving a “range” equal to or greater than 300 km and capable of providing a navigational accuracy of 200m Circular Error Probable (CEP) or less.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: ‘综合导航系统’通常包括以下“零件”和“组件”：
text.en: An ‘ integrated navigation system’ typically incorporates the following “parts” and “components”:

text.zh: 1. 惯性测量装置（例如姿态航向参考系统、惯性参考单元或惯性导航系统）；
text.en: 1. An inertial measurement device (e.g., an attitude and heading reference system, inertial reference unit, or inertial navigation system);

text.zh: 2. 在整个飞行期间定期或连续更新位置和/或速度的一个或多个外部传感器（例如卫星导航接收机、雷达高度表和/或多普勒雷达）；且
text.en: 2. One or more external sensors used to update the position and/or velocity, either periodically or continuously throughout the flight (e.g., satellite navigation receiver, radar altimeter, and/or Doppler radar); and

text.zh: 3. 集成硬件和软件。
text.en: 3. Integration hardware and software.

text.zh: 相关管制：(1) 另见7A005、7A611和7A994。(2) 受ITAR管辖的GNSS接收设备见USML第XII类(d)款；受ITAR管辖的天线见USML第XI类(c)(10)款。(3) 原本可能属于ECCN 7A105.b.2范围的物项“受ITAR管辖”（见《联邦法规汇编》第22编第120至130部分）。(4) 7A105.a、b.1和b.3中受ITAR管辖的GPS接收设备见USML第XII类(d)款。
text.en: Related Controls: (1) See also 7A005, 7A611 and 7A994. (2) See USML Category XII(d) for GNSS receiving equipment subject to the ITAR and USML Category XI(c)(10) for antennae that are subject to the ITAR. (3) Items that otherwise would be covered by ECCN 7A105.b.2 are “subject to the ITAR” (see 22 CFR parts 120 through 130). (4) See USML Category XII(d) for GPS receiving equipment in 7A105.a, b.1 and b.3 that are subject to the ITAR.

text.zh: 相关定义：‘导航卫星系统’包括全球导航卫星系统（GNSS，例如GPS、GLONASS、Galileo或北斗）和区域导航卫星系统（RNSS，例如NavIC、QZSS）。
text.en: Related Definitions: 'Navigation satellite systems' include Global Navigation Satellite Systems (GNSS; e.g. GPS, GLONASS, Galileo or BeiDou) and Regional Navigation Satellite Systems (RNSS; e.g. NavIC, QZSS).

text.zh: 物项：a. 设计或改装用于“导弹”；或
text.en: Items: a. Designed or modified for use in “missiles”; or

text.zh: b. 设计或改装用于机载应用，且具有以下任一特性：
text.en: b. Designed or modified for airborne applications and having any of the following:

text.zh: b.1. 能够在速度超过600 m/s时提供导航信息；
text.en: b.1. Capable of providing navigation information at speeds in excess of 600 m/s;

text.zh: b.2. 采用为军事或政府服务设计或改装的解密功能，以获取‘导航卫星系统’的安全信号/数据；或
text.en: b.2. Employing decryption, designed or modified for military or governmental services, to gain access to a 'navigation satellite system' secure signal/data; or

text.zh: b.3. “专门设计”采用抗干扰功能（例如零陷控制天线或电子可转向天线），以便在主动或被动对抗环境中工作。
text.en: b.3. Being “specially designed” to employ anti-jam features (e.g., null steering antenna or electronically steerable antenna) to function in an environment of active or passive countermeasures.

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 7A105.b.2和7A105.b.3不管制为商业、民用或生命安全（例如数据完整性、飞行安全）‘导航卫星系统’服务而设计的设备。
text.en: 7A105.b.2 and 7A105.b.3 do not control equipment designed for commercial, civil or Safety of Life (e.g., data integrity, flight safety) 'navigation satellite system' services.

text.zh: 相关管制：(1) 另见7B101、7B102和7B994。(2) 本条不管制用于‘I级维修’或‘II级维修’的测试、校准或对准设备。
text.en: Related Controls: (1) See also 7B101, 7B102 and 7B994. (2) This entry does not control test, calibration or alignment equipment for 'Maintenance level I' or 'Maintenance Level II'.

text.zh: 相关定义：就7B001而言：(1) ‘I级维修’：通过控制显示单元（CDU）的指示或相应子系统的状态信息，在“航空器”上发现惯性导航单元故障。按照制造商手册，可将故障原因定位至发生故障的航线可更换单元（LRU）。操作人员随后拆下该LRU并以备件替换。(2) ‘II级维修’：将故障LRU送至维修车间（制造商的车间或负责II级维修的运营方车间）。维修车间通过各种适当方法测试故障LRU，确认并定位造成故障的车间可更换组件（SRA）模块。拆下该SRA并以可用备件替换，随后将故障SRA（也可能是完整LRU）送至制造商。‘II级维修’不包括受控加速度计或陀螺传感器的拆解或修理。
text.en: Related Definition: For the purposes of 7B001: (1) 'Maintenance Level I': The failure of an inertial navigation unit is detected on the “aircraft” by indications from the Control and Display Unit (CDU) or by the status message from the corresponding sub-system. By following the manufacturer's manual, the cause of the failure may be localized at the level of the malfunctioning Line Replaceable Unit (LRU). The operator then removes the LRU and replaces it with a spare. (2) 'Maintenance Level II': The defective LRU is sent to the maintenance workshop (the manufacturer's or that of the operator responsible for level II maintenance). At the maintenance workshop, the malfunctioning LRU is tested by various appropriate means to verify and localize the defective Shop Replaceable Assembly (SRA) module responsible for the failure. This SRA is removed and replaced by an operative spare. The defective SRA (or possibly the complete LRU) is then shipped to the manufacturer. 'Maintenance Level II' does not include the disassembly or repair of controlled accelerometers or gyro sensors.

text.zh: 相关管制：(1) 另见7D101和7D994。(2) 与7A003.b、7A005、7A103.b、7A105、7A106、7A115、7A116、7A117或7B103相关的“软件”“受ITAR管辖”（见《联邦法规汇编》第22编第120至130部分）。(3) 用于惯性导航系统、惯性设备及为其“专门设计”的“零件”或“组件”，与防务物品直接相关且并非为民用航空器“专门设计”的“软件”“受ITAR管辖”（见《联邦法规汇编》第22编第120至130部分）。
text.en: Related Controls: (1) See also 7D101 and 7D994. (2) The “software” related to 7A003.b, 7A005, 7A103.b, 7A105, 7A106, 7A115, 7A116, 7A117, or 7B103 is “subject to the ITAR” (see 22 CFR parts 120 through 130). (3) “Software” for inertial navigation systems and inertial equipment and “parts” or “components” “specially designed” therefor that are directly related to defense articles and not “specially designed” for use on civil aircraft is “subject to the ITAR” (see 22 CFR parts 120 through 130).
